baseline.glyph_red_control: After core data fix but before provider edits, actual native scene graph retained2/3/5 SoShape nodes for Bearing/Gear/Pulley after invalid Location. GUI assertions failed for all three; process exit0 was not treated as semantic success.

cause: The References callback computed the location intersection and offset, while separate Location/Dist callbacks stored the raw cylinder center. Degenerate/unsupported geometry reached unchecked OCCT conversions or intersection access. Inherited providers only removed existing glyphs when Height remained positive.
fix: One validated bearing refresh for References/Location/Dist, preserving original References-path seat/axis and signed normal-offset behavior. Reject unsupported, unresolved, multiple and axis-parallel location geometry, nonfinite distance and nonunique/failed intersections with explicit diagnostics and native Invalid state on recompute. Clear invalid derived geometry and remove Bearing/Gear/Pulley glyphs; recovery rebuilds them. Skip partial property restoration, use global location scope for placed occurrences, and make cylinder-parameter extraction return false for unsupported topology.

compatibility.distance: Positive Dist translates the location plane toward the existing reference base, negative away. It is a normal offset, not axial distance; oblique-plane test qualifies the distinction. If the reference base already lies on the plane, preserve legacy ignored-offset behavior.
compatibility.no_location: Clearing Location restores the original References-path default. Dist has no effect without Location. Native cylinder parameterization/axis sign was retained, not replaced with an assumed positive axis.
compatibility.movement: Location occurrence and common parent placement changes refresh on ordinary document recompute; no manual References reassignment is needed. Immediate placement callbacks beyond existing behavior are not claimed.
